XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Vehicles equipped with:
    1. Air conditioning system with integrated heating and air conditioning control;

    2. Integrated automatic heating and air conditioning system (IHKA)
  • System: Air conditioning

  • Component: Evaporator

  • Fault: A brief musty odour is noticeable in the passenger compartment immediately after starting the engine whilst the automatic air conditioning or heating system is active, or after switching off the system whilst driving

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Condensation of moisture on the evaporator, combined with impurities in the fresh or recirculated air, promotes the growth of bacteria and mould, causing the unpleasant odour

• Action: Clean the evaporator with a spray lance. If the fault persists, replace the microfilter.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: Spray lance code no. 83 30 2 222 502.

    Spray gun code no. 81 45 9 429 217.

    Spray lance cleaner code no. 83 19 2 180 507
